screen.spotify_controller.setup.title: Spotify Controller - First-Time Setup
screen.spotify_controller.setup.step1.he: Step 1 of 3: Create a Spotify Developer App
screen.spotify_controller.setup.step1.li: 1. Click "Open Spotify Dashboard" below and log in.
2. Click "Create app" in the top-right corner.
3. Enter any App name & description (e.g. "MC Spotify").
4. Under "Which API/SDKs are you planning to use?", check "Web API".
screen.spotify_controller.setup.step1.no: Note: Spotify Premium is required for playback control.
screen.spotify_controller.setup.step2.he: Step 2 of 3: Add the Redirect URL
screen.spotify_controller.setup.step2.li: 1. Click "Copy Redirect URL" below to copy this exact address:
2. Paste it into the "Redirect URIs" field in the dashboard and click "Add".
3. Check the Developer Terms of Service and click "Save" at the bottom.
screen.spotify_controller.setup.step3.he: Step 3 of 3: Paste Your Client ID & Connect
screen.spotify_controller.setup.step3.li: 1. In your Spotify app dashboard, click the "Settings" button.
2. Copy the "Client ID" (you do not need the Client Secret).
3. Paste it below and click "Save & Connect Spotify":
